question: Si cada concesión reparte su petróleo de 2025 entre sus socios según su participación, ¿cuántos metros cúbicos le tocan a YPF?

attempts.query:
WITH pet AS ( SELECT idareapermisoconcesion AS id, SUM(prod_pet) AS pet FROM capitulo4.produccion WHERE anio = 2025 GROUP BY idareapermisoconcesion ), socios AS ( SELECT c.id_concesion AS id, trim(split_part(p, ':', 1)) AS empresa, replace(regexp_replace(split_part(p, ':', 2), '[^0-9,.]', '', 'g'), ',', '.')::numeric AS pct FROM sig_energia.concesion c, LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(c.participacion, '
') AS p WHERE c.participacion IS NOT NULL AND p ~ ':' AND split_part(p, ':', 2) ~ '[0-9]' ) SELECT ROUND(SUM(pet.pet * s.pct / 100), 2) FROM pet JOIN socios s ON s.id = pet.id WHERE upper(s.empresa) ~ '^YPF( |$|\.)'
